name: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade, New Delhi

programs.name: MBA (International Business)
programs.feeNote: MBA 2027 brochure: total fee for MBA (IB) 2026-28 batch at all campuses is Rs 19.73 lakh (tuition, library, computer & internet, medical insurance, alumni & student body). Hostel & mess extra: Delhi Rs 1.35 lakh p.a. (double) / Rs 1.08 lakh p.a. (triple); refundable security Rs 10,000. Exact 2027-29 fee to be communicated with offer letters. SC/ST/PwD: 50% tuition concession.
programs.intakeNote: Batch 2027-29 seats at Delhi campus per MBA 2027 brochure (also 240 Kolkata, 120 Kakinada, 120 GIFT City = 720 MBA(IB) seats in total); reserved per GoI norms.
programs.placementNote: Official IIFT Final Placement Highlights 2025, MBA(IB) batch 2023-25: average CTC 31.30 L (27.30 L in 2022-24), highest 1.23 Cr, top-25% CTC 49.60 L, 135 corporate associations. Median not published; campus coverage not stated. 2024-26 final report not yet posted on iift.ac.in.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting on CAT 2026 score and other defined parameters
selectionProcess.detail: IIFT uses CAT 2026 score for shortlisting/selection for MBA(IB) and MBA(BA) 2027-29; weights of other parameters not published in brochure.

selectionProcess.name: Group Discussion and Personal Interview
selectionProcess.detail: Physical mode at Delhi, Kolkata, Kakinada, GIFT City, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Indore, Lucknow and Mumbai (subject to change).

keyDates.notes: Last date for online application and fee: 25 Nov 2026; CAT 2026 on 29 Nov 2026. Applications via applyadmission.net/iift2027 (linked from iift.ac.in).

sources.title: IIFT MBA (IB) & MBA (BA) 2027-29 brochure
sources.supports: fee (2026-28 batch figure); seats 2027-29; selection process; key dates; approvals
